ns2:section.sectionText: HEDGE FUNDS. Registration restricted to undergraduate Finance majors thru Nov 25. Any remaining seats will open to other College of Business students at approximately noon on Nov 26. Prerequisite (FIN 300) will be enforced. Students are strongly encouraged to have also completed FIN 311 prior to enrollment in FIN 490 Hedge Funds.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or Business Administration or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
